summary: This is a routine earnings press release filed on Form 6-K by FirstService Corp, a Canadian foreign private issuer, reporting first-quarter results for the period ended March 31, 2026. The filing discloses revenues of $1.32 billion, Adjusted EBITDA of $105.7 million, and GAAP EPS of $0.44, along with operating segment highlights. There is no mention of any merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change. The press release is a standard quarterly update on financial performance and outlook, not a special-situation event.
